provenance.section: Sequence Numbers — "Sequence numbers that are less than the previous number can be ignored or represent a message that has arrived out of order."
modifications: sequence_num changed from 0 to 3, so the frame arrives later in a scenario.
events[0].type changed from "snapshot" to "update" — the other documented value — so this models a redelivery rather than a resubscription snapshot.
Everything else is byte-for-byte the documented example, which is the point: the trade_id and product_id are identical, so the trade is the same trade.

expectation: Parses. Produces NO ReferenceTradeObserved, because trade 000000000 on ETH-USD was already normalized. Emits a COINBASE_DUPLICATE_TRADE anomaly with the raw frame and increments tradesDuplicateSuppressed. Suppression is recorded, never silent.
